subject: Request: temporary rate elevation & settlement plan for May overusage
messages:
From: Erin Zhang <erin@cloudwave.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Cc: Kevin O'Neill <kevin@cloudwave.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Jun 2027 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Spike in May usage — need short-term rate change and settlement options

Hi Priyom / Ben,

Quick note from CloudWave — we just finished a paid marketing push in May and blew through our normal API allowance. During the peak window (~May 18-20) we started getting throttles and a handful of rejected requests which impacted a customer-facing flow. We attached a CSV with May usage broken down by day.

Two asks:
- Can Redwood offer a short-term increase to our rate limits for the remainder of this month (or an agreed backstop window) so we don't see repeated 429s while we stabilize traffic?
- Separately, we want to square up the overage. We'd expect to pay for the extra tokens but are requesting a modest reduction on the standard overage multiplier given this was a one-off campaign.

We can sign any acknowledgement form and will pay by card. Please advise fastest path — temporary uplift vs. immediate true-up invoice vs. converting to a short-term reserved capacity.

Attachments: usage_report_May2027.csv (summary)

Thanks,
Erin
Erin Zhang
Head of Platform Ops, CloudWave
erin@cloudwave.com
From: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Jun 2027 09:20:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Spike in May usage — need short-term rate change and settlement options

Thanks Erin — looping in finance and accounts.

Ben / Laura — key facts: CloudWave (CW-2027-04) exceeded tokens during a brief paid campaign; they want a short-lived rate elevation to avoid immediate throttles and are open to a billed true-up. They specifically asked for a reduced overage multiplier.

Options I propose (we should agree on one):
1) Provisional rate elevation: enable a temporary uplift for 48-72 hours to avoid more 429s; bill the provisional uplift at a 1.25x multiplier on token unit price; true-up final invoice with exact tokens after we confirm usage. Requires signed acknowledgement form.
2) Immediate true-up invoice: bill the overage for May at our standard overage x1.5 multiplier; offer a one-time discount (30% off the overage portion) as a concession.
3) Short-term reserved add-on: they commit to an incremental reserved capacity for July (1–3 month minimum) and we apply a credit toward the overage.

Laura — can you confirm which option finance can approve as an exception and whether we can offer condensed payment terms (e.g., 7-day early-pay discount)? I've attached a provisional request form we can send to CloudWave if we go option 1.

Attachments: provisional_rate_elevation_form.pdf

Cheers,
Priyom
Priyom Das
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
From: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Jun 2027 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Spike in May usage — need short-term rate change and settlement options

Priyom — thanks for the summary. Finance stance: we can approve a provisional uplift as an exception with controls, but need the following to process quickly:

- Signed acknowledgement form listing uplift window and provisional multiplier.
- Agreement to a true-up invoice to be issued within 7 business days after the uplift window closes.
- Payment terms for the true-up: Net 30 standard, but we can offer a 10% discount on the overage portion if the invoice is paid within 7 days.
- We prefer a provisional multiplier of no more than 1.2x for temporary exceptions (higher multipliers set a pricing precedent).

If they decline the provisional path, we can issue an overage invoice with a one-time 25% concession on the overage portion instead of the uplift. This will be applied as a credit line on their billing account.

I will generate the billing note and exception approval memo once Ben confirms the uplift window and Erin signs the acknowledgement.

Attachment: signed-settlement-email-stub.txt (will be replaced with the signed form from CloudWave)

-Laura
Laura Bennett
Director, Finance Operations, Redwood Inference
From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
To: Erin Zhang <erin@cloudwave.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Jun 2027 15:30:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Spike in May usage — need short-term rate change and settlement options

Erin — thanks for the heads up and sorry about the throttles. Quick recap and proposed path to get you back to stable traffic: 

- We're prepared to enable a provisional rate elevation starting 2027-06-16 00:00 UTC for 48 hours (ends 2027-06-18 00:00 UTC).
- Billing: provisional uplift billed at 1.2x token rate (finance approved), with a final true-up invoice issued within 7 business days after the window closes based on actual tokens consumed.
- Payment: Net 30, with a 10% discount on the overage portion if paid within 7 days.
- Requirement: sign the attached provisional acknowledgement and confirm billing card on file.

If you prefer a direct invoice instead of the uplift, we can issue an overage invoice for May with a 25% concession on overage.

Please review and reply with the signed form. If all good, we'll flip the uplift on at 00:00 UTC tomorrow.

On Tue, Jun 15, 2027 at 08:12 AM Erin Zhang <erin@cloudwave.com> wrote:
> Quick note from CloudWave — we just finished a paid marketing push in May and blew through our normal API allowance...

Thanks,
Ben
Ben Carter
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
From: Erin Zhang <erin@cloudwave.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>
Cc: Kevin O'Neill <kevin@cloudwave.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 18 Jun 2027 16:44:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Spike in May usage — need short-term rate change and settlement options

Ben / Priyom / Laura — all good from our side.

We signed the provisional acknowledgement and uploaded it to the link you provided (attaching a stub here for records). We confirm acceptance of the 1.2x provisional uplift for the 48-hour window (2027-06-16 00:00 UTC to 2027-06-18 00:00 UTC). We also accept the Net 30 payment terms with the 10% early-pay discount option.

We have a card on file for immediate settlement; please send the true-up invoice once available and we'll prioritize payment.

Attachment: signed-provisional-form.pdf (stub)

Appreciate the quick turnaround — we'll follow up after our post-campaign review with options to smooth capacity for future events.

Best,
Erin
Erin Zhang
Head of Platform Ops, CloudWave
